d: The guys face rivers and vegetation, drug lords, the effects of high elevation and the world's most perilous highway in the Bolivian rainforest.

st: UK: The One with the £340,000 Lexus
d: Jeremy Clarkson makes a film about the BMW X6 and ends up conducting one of the most expensive road tests in "Top Gear" history  James May drives the new Vauxhall Insignia VXR  Richard Hammond tests the Lexus supercar.
James attempts to drive a Toyota Hilux up an active volcano in Iceland, and The Stig rips up the track in the new Bentley Continental Supersports.

st: UK: The One with Cheap Sports Saloons
d: Jeremy, Richard and James find a trio of cars which are equally at home on the racetrack as they are at transporting a family to the store.
The cars put to the test include the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte in a search for the world's greatest four seat supercar.
The boys build cool and interesting motor homes before setting off for a holiday weekend in the West country.
